_comment: Day-phase, cripple and interrogation tuning that used to be magic numbers inside heresyGameManager.js and src/mechanics/. Values here are the EXACT current engine behaviour as of the 2026-07-27 extraction — nothing was re-balanced while moving it. Win conditions are deliberately absent: heretic parity (living heretics >= living loyalists) and the Loyalist condition have no tunable parameter, so exposing them here would be a knob that does nothing.

day._comment: FIRST_VOTING_ROUND 2 encodes 'Day 1 is chat-only, no vote' (Q28). STAND_DOWN_MAJORITY is a strict fraction of living players: skips > alive * 0.5 disperses the conclave. EXECUTION_THRESHOLD is the Tiered Lynch cut (tiered-lynch.md): a leader clearing ceil(alive * 0.6) is executed, below it they are tortured instead. Ties are broken by highest drift; if drift cannot break the tie the day is skipped.

cripple._comment: Torture damage tiers. MAX_TIER caps escalation. At JUSTIFY_VOTES_AT_TIER a player must supply a written justification with every vote. PERMANENT_AT_TIER is where damage stops expiring: below it, tier 1 lapses once tier1_until_round passes; at or above it the tier is permanent. It currently equals JUSTIFY_VOTES_AT_TIER but is a SEPARATE concept — do not collapse them, or raising the justify threshold would silently make tier-2 damage temporary.

proximitySiphon._comment: Conclave Proximity Siphon (v2.6.0). Imperial Citizens take 30% floored at 1 of any Conclave-list neighbor's drift-charging night action cost. See projects/heresy-rising/mechanics/drift.md v2.6.0 § Conclave Proximity Siphon.

interrogation._comment: Interrogator scan resolution. A scan's effective tier is min(MAX_SCAN_TIER, chosenIntensity + zoneTierUpgrade[targetZone]). Execute on Sight fires when chosenIntensity >= EXECUTE_ON_SIGHT_MIN_INTENSITY AND the target's zone upgrade >= EXECUTE_ON_SIGHT_MIN_ZONE_UPGRADE — with the table below that means T2+ against Red or Black only (Q25, locked 2026-07-25; engine synced to spec per Q-AUDIT-EoS 2026-07-30). Orange is intel-only: confirmed warp-taint, no auto-kill. T1_ACCURACY is the chance a Tier 1 Clean/Tainted read is truthful. GENTLE_ROLE_* halve the zone noise rate for low-drift-weight roles (Chirurgeon, Novice-Psychic, Arbitrator, Conspirator). NOISE_UNCLEAR_CHANCE splits a noisy result between 'unclear' and an inverted answer.
